parsed.note: Changing DEPTH to 24 only alters the model architecture while training still uses shards 0-11 and the fixed evaluation (shard 12, val split) is untouched, so val_bpb still measures real quality—though the reported numbers look inverted since lower bpb is better (1.092 is worse than 1.059).
